---
title: "Interactive demos"
---

One short interactive demo per day, embedded in that day's Exercises page.
Predict what will happen before you move a control, then explain why it
happened.

| Day | Interactive exploration | Question to investigate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | [Molecules and hidden hydrogens](../structures/exercise.qmd#explore) | Inspect atom counts and connectivity |
| 2 | [Interactions and properties](../properties/exercise.qmd#explore) | Compare donors, acceptors and molecular properties |
| 3 | [Aqueous ionisation](../acids-bases/exercise.qmd#explore) | Change pH and pKa and inspect the population |
| 4 | [Functional-group inspector](../practice/day04.qmd#explore) | Find groups in molecules with more than one feature |
| 5 | [Ionisation and extraction](../practice/day05.qmd#explore) | Supply the additional partition information explicitly |
| 6 | [Rotate a Newman projection](../conformations/exercise.qmd#explore) | Relate a changing dihedral to a conformational view |
| 7 | [Fischer configurations](../stereochemistry/exercise.qmd#explore) | Compare mirror images, swaps and valid rotations |
| 8 | [Repair electron flow](../mechanisms/exercise.qmd#explore) | Choose electron sources and destinations |
| 9 | [Conformer populations](../practice/day09.qmd#explore) | Explore supplied relative free energies and temperature |
| 10 | [Enantiomer mixtures](../practice/day10.qmd#explore) | Distinguish major fraction from enantiomeric excess |
| 11 | [Reaction rate models](../substitution/exercise.qmd#explore) | Compare assumed SN1 and SN2 concentration dependence |
| 12 | [E2 geometry](../elimination-addition/exercise.qmd#explore) | Find the anti-periplanar arrangement |
| 13 | [Alcohol oxidation states](../alcohols-redox/exercise.qmd#explore) | Track local C–O and C–H bond changes |
| 14 | [SN1 steps and charge](../practice/day14.qmd#explore) | Inspect ionisation, capture and proton transfer |
| 15 | [Limiting reagent and yield](../practice/day15.qmd#explore) | Change amounts and separate mass yield from purity |
| 16 | [Carbonyl addition](../carbonyl-addition/exercise.qmd#explore) | Follow oxygen identities and proton transfers |
| 17 | [Acyl substitution](../acyl-chemistry/exercise.qmd#explore) | Link addition, collapse and acid–base trapping |
| 18 | [Amine protonation](../amines-aromatics/exercise.qmd#explore) | Compare supplied conjugate-acid pKas at a chosen pH |
| 19 | [Proton-transfer equilibria](../practice/day19.qmd#explore) | Compare acid/base pairs without claiming reaction speed |
| 20 | [Amide electron availability](../practice/day20.qmd#explore) | Inspect resonance and a nitrogen lone pair |
| 21 | [Spectral candidate lab](../spectroscopy/exercise.qmd#explore) | Combine supplied formula, IR and NMR observations |
| 22 | [TLC measurements](../synthesis-evidence/exercise.qmd#explore) | Measure distances and compare retention factors |
| 23 | [Build a short synthesis](../integration/exercise.qmd#explore) | Choose transformations and inspect their consequences |
| 24 | [How strong is a spectral clue?](../practice/day24.qmd#explore) | Change the available evidence and test a claim |
| 25 | [Claims and chemical evidence](../practice/day25.qmd#explore) | Separate identity, purity, conversion and isolated yield |
